description: WTGs would be sited in a uniform east-west/north-south grid with 1.15-mile spacing.
context_quote: Turbines would be sited in a uniform east-west/north-south grid with 1.15 by 1.15-mile (mi) (1 by 1-nautical mile [nm]; 1.85 by 1.85 kilometer [km]) spacing.

description: WTG monopile foundations would be 39 ft in diameter at the seabed and 23 ft in diameter at the sea surface.
context_quote: The WTG foundations as proposed in the COP would be 39 ft (12 m) in diameter at the seabed and 23 ft (7 m) in diameter at the sea surface (Sunrise Wind 2022).

description: OCS-DC would have a four-legged piled jacket foundation.
context_quote: The OCS-DC would have a four-legged piled jacket OCS-DC foundation.

description: Inter-array cables would have a total length of approximately 180 miles.
context_quote: The inter-array cable (IAC) would carry the electrical current produced by the WTGs to the OCS-DC. The cables would be installed within a 90-ft (30-m)-wide corridor, have a total length of approximately 180 mi (289.7 km), and would have a typical target depth of 3 to 7 ft (1 to 2 m).

description: Offshore export cables would be buried to a target depth of 3 to 7 ft.
context_quote: The SRWEC would be located in federal and New York state waters and would be one 320-kilovolt (kV) DC export cable bundle buried to a target depth of 3 to 7 feet (ft) (1 to 2 meters [m]).

description: Temporary pile-supported pier would extend approximately 240 feet offshore and be approximately 16-feet wide.
context_quote: To allow for the transportation of equipment and materials from Long Island to the construction site on Fire Island, a temporary pile-supported pier would be constructed on the inshore side of Fire Island. The pier would extend approximately 240 feet (73 m) offshore and be approximately 16-feet (4.9-m) wide.
